title: Fallout 3 — James Session Autopersistence / Storage Association Audit v1.7
question: Does the exact James Vault 112 session graph contain a shipped persistent-storage, backend-state, hidden-object or transferable-payload association strong enough to bind James's 2277 session to persisted memory without requiring a player-visible COPY/WRITE command?

reason_for_gate.basis: Pinkerton removed an already-populated memory carrier from Braun's custody and later integrated its payload into A3-21; therefore some internal memory-to-carrier process existed even though its producer opcode is not exposed on the reviewed public terminal surface.
reason_for_gate.not_target: Invent a mandatory manual WRITE button.

james_monitor_base.role: James-specific lounger monitor / physical session selector

exit_controller.known_public_mirror_behavior: Opens MQ04DadPodShellRef and MQ04PlayerPodShellRef separately and restores MQDadRef physical state on exit.

shared_backend_context.model: Think Machine 3600r runs/synchronizes the main simulation while smaller per-lounger systems handle local graphics/medical state.
shared_backend_context.testable_implication: A resident-specific persisted state may be attached to pod-local or shared-backend objects rather than exposed directly in MQ04Script.

discovery_layers.seed_leaf_links: Export every parsed leaf from exact seed records and preserve any linked FormID/EditorID/name.
discovery_layers.reverse_references: Export official-master ReferencedBy edges for each seed.
discovery_layers.placed_seed_instances: Bind placed REFR instances whose base is a James/session seed, including exact location and lifecycle fields.
discovery_layers.pod_local_inventory: Export every effective REFR in canonical cell Vault112a with base identity, XYZ, Initially Disabled, XESP, ownership and scripts.
discovery_layers.broad_storage_candidates: Scan all effective official records for memory/persistence/storage/backend terms, without assigning semantics from keywords alone.

proximity_policy.purpose: Prioritize pod-local physical objects around the exact placed James monitor without turning co-location into function.
proximity_policy.high_priority_local_candidate: Within 512 units of an exact James monitor placement AND storage/persistence identity is present AND a direct lifecycle/dependency marker is present.

admission_ladder.meaning: storage keyword or pod-local proximity only
direct linked form from a James seed OR storage candidate reverse-references an exact James seed
pod-local object has storage identity plus dependency/lifecycle edge, or primary seed linkage names a persistence/storage object
primary shipped record semantics bind James's exact session/pod/Doc state to a persistent resident-specific storage state or selectable payload
persisted James-derived payload is independently bound to the removable/transferable memory-carrier class compatible with Pinkerton import

secondary_dithers_hypothesis.claim_encountered: Older secondary Fallout documentation describes the stolen Vault 112 chip as T. Dithers' resident-specific rewritable memory chip and interprets her awareness as a consequence of its removal.
secondary_dithers_hypothesis.promotion_requirement: Primary ESM record/reference/script binding is required.

next_gate.name: JAMES_SESSION_REAL_ESM_STORAGE_ASSOCIATION_RECEIPT_v1.7
completion: Run v1.7 exporter with exactly six official masters.
Freeze SHA-256 of all five TSV outputs before interpretation.
Bind the exact placed Vault112PodTermDad monitor REFR and inspect its 128/512/1024 unit neighborhood.
Review every direct linked form and reverse reference from James session seeds.
Manually inspect all source-bound/high-priority persistence candidates.
Promote only if primary semantics establish a resident/session-specific persisted state or transferable James payload.
